articles.title: What $25,000 a Night Buys on a Luxury Cruise Line
articles.mainIdea: What $25,000 a Night Buys on a Luxury Cruise Line
articles.summary: The Wall Street Journal: What $25,000 a Night Buys on a Luxury Cruise Line. One of the newest Four Seasons suites includes a private outdoor gym, panoramic floor-to-ceiling windows and a gilded spiral staircase snaking between its four floors. Unlike the hotel brand’s other luxury accommodations, this one can travel at 17 knots. The penthouse—bookable for $50,000 a night—is part of Four Seasons Yachts, a new luxury cruise line from Four Seasons Hotels & Resorts and Marc-Henry Cruise Holdings.
